# L1 test harness

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Agent / harness · **Label:** `feature:l1-test-harness` · **Epic:** [#436](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/436) · **Tickets:** 0 ()

One Go test process starts the real worker and the real control plane on loopback, with fakes for everything outside Warden (upstreams, DNS, time, trust roots), and checks behaviour through Warden's own outputs. Every feature below adds a fake and a scenario to it instead of building its own test rig. Built and tracked under #350.

## Done when

Merged under #350: `go test ./test/scenarios -race` boots the real control plane and worker in one process and runs the scenario catalog, the canary oracle fails any scenario that leaks a secret, and the port-coverage test fails CI for any port interface without a registered fake.

## Needs first

Nothing. This feature can start now.
